products.title: Products
products.description: Your product catalog — SKU, pricing, and stock reorder levels.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU, or barcode…

actions.activateDescription: Activate "{name}"? It will become sellable again.
actions.deactivateDescription: Deactivate "{name}"? It won't be sellable until reactivated.

stock.title: Stock by location — {name}
stock.description: How much of this product is at each of your locations right now.
stock.empty: No stock recorded for this product at any location yet.
stock.truncatedNotice: Showing {shown} of {total} — see the full Reporting screen (coming soon) for the complete list.

form.createDescription: Add a new product to your catalog.
form.skuLength: SKU must be at most 60 characters.
form.skuDescription: Cannot be changed after the product is created.
form.name: Name
form.reorderLevelDescription: You'll be alerted when stock falls below this amount.
form.pricePositive: Must be zero or a positive number.
form.sellByWeightDescription: Turn on for items sold by weight, like rice or vegetables, instead of by piece.

bulkImport.title: Bulk import products
bulkImport.description: Upload a CSV file to add or update many products at once.
bulkImport.uploadHelp: Use the template above, or any CSV with the same column headers. Existing SKUs will be updated; new SKUs will be created.
bulkImport.parseError: Could not read this file. Make sure it's a valid CSV.
bulkImport.emptyFileError: This file has no rows to import.
bulkImport.previewSummary: {createCount} to create, {updateCount} to update, {errorCount} with errors
bulkImport.previewErrorNotice: Rows with errors will be skipped — the rest will still import.
bulkImport.confirmPartialErrorNotice: {errorCount} rows were skipped due to errors.

variants.title: Variants — {name}
variants.description: Manage the Size/Color-style attributes and the specific variants (each with its own SKU and price) for this product.
variants.attributeValuesPlaceholder: Comma-separated values, e.g. S, M, L
variants.attributeNameAndValuesRequired: Enter an attribute name and at least one value.
variants.noAttributesYet: No attributes yet — add one (e.g. Size, Color) to start building variants.
variants.skuAndAttributesRequired: Enter a SKU and select a value for every attribute.
variants.deleteDescription: Delete this variant? This cannot be undone, and only works if it has no stock, sale, or purchase history.
variants.empty: No variants yet — add one above.
